screen_policy: Every slide must prove the exact copy through visible Aachu/Zuv behavior. Any doubtful slide blocks image generation until repaired and re-reviewed.

slide_reviews.copy:
This is the kind of love
I want us to grow into.

We will still get irritated
over wrong turns
and very small things.

I will still say,
“Don’t talk to me.”

I hope we learn
which part to hear.

Not “go away.”
Just:
“Give me a minute. Don’t go far.”

And when I’m ready,
I’ll come back and ask:
“Chai?”

Not less irritated.
Just better
at coming back.

director_storyboard.physical_event: A couple disagrees over directions in their parked car, withdraws into silence, steps outside, establishes a boundary, waits at a respectful distance, reconnects through a chai invitation, and returns to playful irritation.
director_storyboard.emotional_arc: shared exasperation to silence to explicit space to respectful nearness to cautious reassurance to woman-led reconnection to mutual play
director_storyboard.relationship_change: They move from pointing in opposite directions to honoring a boundary and freely choosing each other again.
director_storyboard.sequence_read: After a rainy navigation disagreement leaves a couple withdrawn, the woman asks for space, the man respects it, and she freely returns to reconnect over roadside chai until their irritation becomes play.
